How the still works

A still is set up once, with a cut and a chain of infusers, and then only ever does two things: Feed it a batch, which cuts and infuses each event exactly once as it arrives, and Distill it with a recipe, which hands the infused events to the recipe and returns whatever spirit it makes — a pure read, as often as you like. The infusers below are read off the chain the tests use, in order.

1 · A request

One mpv2 request per interaction, as the client sends it: its event, and an envelope — what upstream knows beyond the event. A visit is many requests under one session id.

envelope: At · Session · Personalization consent

→

2 · Cut

Config.Cut keeps or cuts each event. It sees the envelope, so it can cut by where an event came from as well as by what it is.

affinity still: keeps selections, views and carts — nothing else, no listings · consent still: those, and only from batches with personalization consent

→

3 · Infusers, in order, once per event

    {{range .Infusers}}
  1. {{.Name}} — {{.Doc}}
    2. {{end}}

each starts from what the one before returned; the envelope is dropped after this step

→

4 · The still

Kept events with their infusion, in arrival order: Infused{Event, Infusion}, where the infusion is At · Session · Affinity. Never rewritten; only drawn off.

→

5 · Draw off

A Rule selects what the still should no longer hold: by position, name, time or session, composed with Any, All and Not. It runs as a standing policy after every feed, and on request.

affinity still: keeps the newest {{.Keep}} choices · on request, e.g. InSession(id) to forget a visit

→

anything relative to now, like decay, happens here and nowhere earlier

One visit, request by request

{{.Batch}}, run through the chain above one infuser at a time. Each column is what that infuser made of the event: the envelope stamped on, the taste its items carry — one vector, dresses, trousers and lamps alike — and finally the weight it is scaled by: a selection in full, the cart three times over. Listings never get that far: the affinity still keeps only the choices it learns from, and cuts everything else at the door.
